FrySharp table.description: Show a list of structs (or tuples, or a map) as a sortable, filterable table

FrySharp line chart.description: Show numbers as a line chart

FrySharp bar chart.description: Show numbers as a bar chart

FrySharp input.description: Ask the notebook for a line of input (None is the end of input)

FrySharp crate.description: Use a crate from crates.io: it is downloaded when the cell runs

FrySharp share a value.description: Offer a variable to other languages' cells (#!share --from rust name)

FrySharp share from another language.description: Copy a variable of another language's kernel into this cell
